records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Personnel
records.english: You can assign officers to jobs automatically. Choose Auto on the Deck screen, then select [[107|Exploration]], [[108|Trade]] or [[109|Naval Battle]].
records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Automatic officer placement; source Deck triangle action opens policy selection: exploration/trade/naval combat.
records.localization_note: Name the translated Auto action rather than repeating the source platform triangle symbol. Preserve all three policy links.
records.source_Japanese_with_link_IDs:
人事（共通コマンド→甲板画面）
担当を自動で配置できます。
甲板画面で△を押し、方針を「探検航海」「交易」「海戦」から選びます。
→[[107|探検航海]]　→[[108|交易]]　→[[109|海戦]]

clean_neighbors.source:
甲板画面（共通コマンド）
甲板画面を表示します。
甲板画面では、航海士の担当を決められます。航海士を選んで部屋に配置すると、部屋の種類によって航海士の担当が決まります。
各担当には、[[133|必要な能力]]があります。能力が不足していると、担当につけません。能力が高いほど、担当を配置した効果も高くなります。
→[[106|人事]]　→[[110|担当室]]　→[[127|船倉]]

探検航海（甲板画面→人事）
担当を探検に適した配置にします。
能力の高い航海士を、探検航海に関係する担当へ優先的に配置します。

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Exploration
records.english: This policy arranges officers for exploration. It gives priority to highly skilled officers in jobs useful for exploring.
records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Exploration-suited assignments; high-ability officers prioritized for relevant jobs.
records.localization_note: Do not reduce the policy to a guessed pair of skills.

records.heading: Workrooms
records.english: These are the rooms where officers perform their assigned jobs. See [[111|Private Cabin]], [[112|Recreation Room]], [[113|Lumber Room]], [[114|Infirmary]], [[115|Galley]], [[116|Livestock Room]], [[117|Chapel]], [[118|Strategy Room]], [[119|Purser's Office]], [[120|Captain's Cabin]], [[121|First Mate's Office]], [[122|Ship's Wheel]], [[123|Survey Room]], [[124|Lookout Tower]], [[125|Masts]] and [[126|Deck]].
records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.

個室（共通コマンド→甲板画面）
航海士が休息する部屋です。配置された航海士の身体や精神の状態が回復します。

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Private Cabin
records.english: Officers rest here. Assigning an officer to a Private Cabin improves their physical condition and mood.
records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Rest room restores assigned navigator body and mental states.
records.localization_note: Retain both kinds of recovery without inventing an instant full heal.

clean_neighbors.source:

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Recreation Room
records.english: Officers and sailors rest here. Assigning an officer to this room slows the increase in crew fatigue and helps the officer recover from fatigue and improve their mood.
records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Crew/navigator rest; assignment lowers fatigue growth for sailors and restores navigator fatigue/mental state.
records.localization_note: Distinguish crew fatigue prevention from the assigned officer's recovery.

材木室（共通コマンド→甲板画面）
船を修理するための材木がある部屋です。
配置した航海士は「船大工」になります。配置できるのは、測量術 130以上の航海士です。
船大工がいると、航海中に船を修理してもらえます。造船所での修理の費用も安く済みます。

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Lumber Room
records.english: This room stores lumber for repairs. Officers assigned here become Shipwrights and need Survey 130 or higher. A Shipwright repairs the ship during voyages and reduces repair costs at shipyards.
records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Repair timber room; Shipwright requires Survey>=130. Voyage repairs and cheaper shipyard repairs.
records.localization_note: Preserve threshold and both repair benefits.

records.heading: Infirmary
records.english: Sick people are treated here. Officers assigned here become Surgeons and need Observe 150 or higher. A Surgeon makes illness less likely and slows the increase in crew fatigue. Having a Surgeon also lets you use items that cure illness.
records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Medical room; surgeon Observe>=150. Reduces disease likelihood/fatigue growth and enables disease-curing item use.
records.localization_note: Match Surgeon in the established native role table; retain item-use eligibility.

records.localization_note: Keep both supplies and fatigue effects; Aim is the source requirement, not Finance.

records.source_meaning: Food livestock room; keeper vitality>=130. Produces food while sailing.
records.localization_note: Use the existing Health skill label from Sailor Info and distinguish it from physical condition.

【！】主義信条により、礼拝室に配置されるのを拒む航海士もいます。

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Chapel
records.english: Officers and sailors worship here. Officers assigned here become Missionaries and need Social 160 or higher. A Missionary slows the increase in crew fatigue and lets you [[43|Distribute Goods]] at the square to start a [[25|Trend]]. Some officers refuse this assignment because of their beliefs.
records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Worship room; missionary persuasion>=160. Slows fatigue; distribute products at square can initiate trend. Some officers refuse for convictions.
records.localization_note: Preserve both links and the belief-based refusal; do not invent a specific religion.

参謀が策略を練る部屋です。
配置した航海士は「参謀」になります。配置できるのは、謀略術 120以上の航海士です。
参謀がひらめくと、酒場で「[[16|策謀の立案]]」を実行できます。敵の策謀を未然に防いでくれることもあります。宿屋に泊まると、他勢力の情報を入手してきます。

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Strategy Room
records.english: Officers assigned here become Strategists and need Tactics 120 or higher. When a Strategist devises a scheme, you can [[16|Plan a Scheme]] at the tavern. They may also stop enemy schemes before they happen. When you stay at an inn, they gather information about other factions.
records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Strategy room; adviser schemes>=120. Inspiration enables tavern plotting; may preempt enemy plots. Inn stay gathers rival faction information.
records.localization_note: Retain inspiration, may, and the inn condition rather than guaranteeing protection.

主計長がいると、交易所で値段をまけてもらえることがあります。また、倍の金額を出せば、商品を買い占められたりもします。ただし、倍の値段では売れません。

records.heading: Purser's Office
records.english: The fleet's accounts are managed here. Officers assigned here become Pursers and need Finance 100 or higher. A Purser may get you lower prices at the market. You may also be able to buy up all available stock by paying twice the price, but you cannot sell at twice the price.
records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Accounting room; purser Finance>=100. May obtain discounts and buy-out stock for double payment; cannot sell for double price.
records.localization_note: Keep the purchase/sale distinction and match Purser in the native role glossary.

records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Commander room accepts protagonist only; becomes captain. Slows fatigue and required for automatic sailing.
records.localization_note: Preserve protagonist-only assignment; source table133 separately lists Command30.

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: First Mate's Office
records.english: This office is for the Captain's assistant. Officers assigned here become First Mates and need Social 100 or higher. A First Mate lets you [[27|Send Diplomatic Documents]] from the guild and slows the increase in crew fatigue. In battles against cities, they demand the city's surrender.
records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Captain assistant room; deputy persuasion>=100. Enables guild document dispatch, slows fatigue and urges city surrender in city battle.
records.localization_note: Use the native First Mate role rather than Adjutant; a surrender demand is not guaranteed success.

副官室（共通コマンド→甲板画面）
艦長の補佐官の部屋です。
配置した航海士は「副官」になります。配置できるのは、説得力 100以上の航海士です。
副官がいると、ギルドで「[[27|交渉文書の発送]]」を実行できます。また、水夫の疲労度が上がりにくくなります。街との戦闘では、街に降伏を勧告します。

艦長がいると、水夫の疲労度が上がりにくくなります。

操舵手がいると、船の向きを変えやすくなります。船の自動移動中の速度も上がります。

records.heading: Ship's Wheel

records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Rudder control room; helmsman Sailing>=60. Easier heading changes and faster automatic travel.
records.localization_note: Keep the Auto Move scope of the speed benefit.

records.heading: Lookout Tower

A successful shot lets you capture that ship.
records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Mast lookout; Observe>=70. Helps find towns/objects and inspect nearby fleets. High Aim may snipe enemy admiral; success captures its ship.
records.localization_note: Preserve the separate Aim benefit and chance/success conditions.

records.heading: Masts

records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Marine waiting quarters max4; boarding leader sword>=90. Stronger melee and participates in duels.

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Health
records.english: An officer's physical condition has six states: Healthy, Tired, Hurt, Wounded, Dying and Sick. Poor health reduces work efficiency or can prevent an officer from working. Assign them to [[111|a Private Cabin]] to recover. A [[114|Surgeon]] can treat Sick officers with items such as medicine.
records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Six physical states; poor condition reduces/prevents work. Private cabin restores health; ship doctor using medicine/items cures disease.
records.localization_note: Use current Hurt/Wounded distinction. Preserve the Doctor-and-item requirement; do not add Dead to the source list. Role labels match the original native role selector's established English glossary.
records.source_Japanese_with_link_IDs:
身体（人物データ）
体調です。「健康」「疲労」「軽傷」「重傷」「瀕死」「疫病」の６段階あります。
体調が悪いと、担当の仕事の能率が落ちたり、仕事ができなくなったりします。
体調は、航海士を[[111|個室]]に配置すると回復します。「疫病」のときは、薬などのアイテムを[[114|船医]]が使うと回復します。

clean_neighbors.source:
精神（人物データ）
精神的な状態を表します。「ハイ」「元気」「リラックス」「通常」「不機嫌」「混乱」の６段階あります。
「不機嫌」や「混乱」のときは、仕事の効率が下がります。
精神状態は、航海士を[[111|個室]]・[[112|娯楽室]]に配置すると回復します。

基本能力（人物データ）

records.context: Original Deck job/room or related Sailor Info Help; all source-linked neighbors and the existing16-entry native role glossary reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Ship handling ability; high values speed operations and suit helmsman/sail handler; Agility/Spirit relate.
records.localization_note: Preserve both roles and the ship-operation benefit rather than promising unrestricted faster travel. Role labels match the original native role selector's established English glossary.
